target.statement: SVM classifier after hyperparameter tuning achieves 99.12% accuracy (and FAR 0.0091) on the KDD Cup 1999 intrusion dataset, the best among all evaluated classifiers.

compute.basis: KDD Cup 1999 is freely downloadable (~4.9M records, ~700MB); scikit-learn SVM with grid search + 10-fold CV + RFE on a subsample is CPU-feasible, but no code/configs are provided so the full pipeline (preprocessing, RFE, tuning grid, CV protocol) must be re-implemented and the exact 99.12% number is unlikely to be hit exactly.

blockers: No code or configs released; pipeline (RFE, tuning grids, train/test split details) must be reverse-engineered from prose
Paper's dataset statistics are internally inconsistent (e.g., 'unique data points' vs record counts), making exact reproduction of the split ambiguous
Exact 99.12% accuracy depends on unspecified preprocessing and tuning grid, so exact match is unlikely
title: Hyperparameter Tuning-Based Optimized Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Network Intrusion Detection
